_note: Events stop the clock and cover the screen below the attributes (Opus 5.5 version; the same events and the same writing as game/content/events.json on October 11, 2026, with this version's triggers). Pages and answer labels are manuscript IDs; `after` is a description that appears once the event closes. Answers are choices too: `pain` makes one a pain card and costs rapture, which becomes Choice; `requires` locks it until Choice is high enough. `silent` events have no writing yet, so they apply their effect without a break. `closed` answers are locked in the manuscript and have no writing past them. An answer can lead to `answers` of its own (branching, Oct 13); `then: answers` returns to the answers it was among; anything else ends the event. Triggers and the order of pages are provisional.
